title: Query length from a blank tape
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, and $c$ a configuration whose query tape is blank at every integer cell and whose query-tape head is at cell $0$. After running $M$ with oracle $O$ from $c$ for $s$ steps, the query string has length at most $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The query tape is blank at every integer cell initially
The query-tape head starts at cell 0
